summary:
I have successfully applied the fix to address the linearizability stale-read issue and verified the changes by running `/app/test.sh`. 

The fix updates `app/handler.go` to use `ReadLinearizable(key)` instead of `Read(key)` to ensure it asks the leader for the latest commit index. It also updates `app/raft/node.go` to properly advance the commit index within `handleHeartbeat` when receiving heartbeats from the leader. 

All 3 rounds of the linearizability tests are now passing successfully.
